policy: include_only_if_online_text/post/message/file/link can be the act, a qualifying method, or explicit public dissemination element
notes: A classifier candidate is not a legal conclusion.

For many articles the online context alone is insufficient: intent, public character, prior administrative punishment, protected data source, harm and other corpus elements must be checked by the model.
Internet relevance should not be inferred merely because evidence can exist online.
